requirements.text: Base plate is 180 mm wide (X), 120 mm deep (Y), and 8 mm thick.
Base plate rests on the build plate (z = 0).
Four 5 mm through-holes cut for mounting screws.
Mounting holes are placed 12 mm in from each corner of the base plate.
Phone cradle is located on the front-left of the base plate.
Phone backrest is 80 mm wide, 110 mm tall, and 6 mm thick.
Phone backrest leans back 70 degrees from the base plane.
Front lip at the foot of the backrest is 80 mm wide, 12 mm tall, and 6 mm deep to stop phone sliding.
A 10 mm wide, 15 mm deep slot through the lip and backrest for a charging cable.
Tablet slot is located on the right half of the base plate.
Two parallel upright tablet walls are 70 mm wide and 60 mm tall.
Tablet walls are 14 mm apart on their inner faces (12 mm tablet + 1 mm clearance each side).
Open-top storage box is located at the back of the base plate.
Storage box is 160 mm wide, 40 mm deep, and 30 mm tall with 3 mm walls.
Storage box is divided into four equal compartments with 2 mm internal divider walls.
Separate flat lid 160 mm wide, 40 mm deep, and 4 mm thick that covers the storage box.
The lid must stay a separate solid from the box/base.
Lid rotates on two pin hinges along the storage box's back edge.
Pins are 4 mm in diameter and pass through knuckles on both the box and lid with 0.3 mm clearance.
Adjustable parameter for backrest lean angle.
Adjustable parameter for tablet gap.
Adjustable parameter for storage box height.
Adjustable parameter for storage box compartment count.
No fillets or chamfers anywhere on the geometry.
Nothing may go below the base (z >= 0).
